entities.name: State Institute of Russian Language
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Pushkin State Russian Language Institute is a public education centre in Moscow specializing in the teaching of Russian as a foreign language and offering a range of language courses on all levels. It is named after the Russian writer Alexander Pushkin.
